component: Native persistent edge-level JEDEC NOR service

integration_contract.ownership: One initialized instance per actual graph component, persistent across SPI controller reset; no controller or graph dependency inside this service.
integration_contract.electrical: Caller supplies real CS changes and SCLK edges, sampled MOSI and virtual nanoseconds. MISO value and drive-enable are separate outputs. MISO is high-impedance until a supported response begins, and whenever unpowered, deselected, unknown-command or busy-rejected. Electrical graph pulls, not this service, resolve undriven SO.
integration_contract.reset: s3_spi_nor_abort discards the current CS transaction without finalization, preserving committed data, WEL and any previously started busy operation.
integration_contract.power: s3_spi_nor_power advances work to the supplied timestamp first. A real power transition cancels incomplete transactions and unfinished busy work, clears WEL, and preserves committed bytes; restoration starts deselected.
integration_contract.time: s3_spi_nor_advance commits at now_ns >= busy_until_ns. Edge, select, abort and power also advance. The binding may schedule advance at the virtual deadline; no host sleep or internal controller timer. Deadline addition saturates at UINT64_MAX.

profile.mode_convention: Sample MOSI rising; change SO falling. Modes 1/2 are deliberately unsupported, not reinterpreted as mode 0.
profile.configurable: Per-component size, all three JEDEC ID bytes and busy durations. Size is a power of two from 64 KiB through 16 MiB. Durations must be nonzero.
profile.initial_contents: Every byte erased to FF; no preloaded read responses.

commands.9f: Output configured three-byte JEDEC ID, then FF on additional response clocks.
commands.03: 24-bit big-endian address, then sequential data; address wraps across configured capacity.
commands.0b: 24-bit address and exactly one dummy byte, then sequential data.
commands.05: Continuous coherent status bytes: bit0 WIP, bit1 WEL, other bits zero. Remains valid during busy.
commands.06: WREN takes effect only at clean CS deassert with no trailing or partial input.
commands.04: WRDI takes effect only at clean CS deassert with no trailing or partial input.
commands.02: 24-bit address, at least one complete data byte, WEL required. A 256-byte page latch wraps within the starting page; the last input at each wrapped position wins in the latch. Deferred commit applies stored_byte AND latch_byte, never changing a stored zero to one.
commands.20: WEL-required 4-KiB erase of the sector containing the 24-bit address.
commands.d8: WEL-required 64-KiB erase of the block containing the 24-bit address.

profile.commit: Clean CS deassert accepts complete mutating commands, clears WEL and starts WIP. Memory changes atomically only at the virtual completion timestamp.
profile.busy: Only status 05 is accepted while busy; all other opcodes, including ID, read, WREN and WRDI, are rejected for that entire CS transaction even if busy subsequently expires.
profile.invalid_and_partial: Unknown opcode rejects the transaction until CS release. Partial command/address/program-data bytes never commit. Address-only program never starts busy. WREN, WRDI and erase commands with trailing input are invalid. Duplicate CS levels do not create transaction boundaries.
profile.power_failure: Deterministic atomic model: unfinished work is discarded without partial cell changes. Already completed work remains nonvolatile.
profile.bounds: One fallible allocation capped at 16 MiB. Fixed 256-byte page and parser state; input stream length never increases allocation or unbounded counters. Commit work is at most 256 byte ANDs or one bounded capacity erase.

behavioral_tests: Per-chip configurable ID independence and invalid configuration cleanup
Erased storage, sequential reads, fast-read dummy byte, address wrap, modes 0 and 3
WEL gating, deferred exact-deadline completion, 1-to-0 programming and page wrap
Busy rejection of every modeled non-status opcode and no mid-CS revival
Partial opcodes, partial addresses, partial payloads, WREN/WRDI and CS boundaries
Sector, block and both chip-erase aliases with neighboring data preservation
Controller-reset persistence, actual power transitions and pending program/erase cancellation
Independent SO drive-enable, MOSI non-echo and falling-only output transitions

verification.status: Not run by service author as instructed; parent owns delegated verification after integration.
verification.required: Wire a QEMU GLib unit executable linking the actual service C and run all /esp32s3/spi-nor tests, then run ordinary IDF SPI2/3 graph/GPIO/electrical qualification.
